findings.explanation: The endpoint does not verify ownership or role before returning user data, violating the policy rule that a user may read or update ONLY their own profile and administrators may read or update any profile.

evidence.content:
- A user may read or update ONLY their own profile (`/users/<id>`). Administrators may read or update any profile. Use
  `is_owner_or_admin(current_user, user_id)` for this check.

findings.suggested_fix: Add a check to ensure the current user is either the owner of the user being accessed or an administrator before returning data.
